pattern: Post starts 'Palisades'/'Alpine' and gives 'N lifts', 'Open at <time>' or 'lifts scheduled for'
'Open:' / 'Now open:' / 'Operating Update' lift roster (status snapshot, lifts listed with no verb)
'<lifts> is/are (now) on a [cause] hold' or 'will start/begin the day on [cause] hold'
Section header form 'Wind Hold: <lifts>' / 'Mechanical Hold:' / 'Patrol Hold:'
'expected to go on wind hold', 'going on a wind hold any minute', 'winds may impact lifts', 'likely snow safety delays'
'All other (scheduled) lifts ... on wind hold / on delay' (lift = ALL_OTHER, with the named lifts as exceptions)
Group scope: 'all upper mountain lifts', 'all lifts at Alpine' ... on hold / delayed / closed (lift = UPPER_MOUNTAIN, LOWER_MOUNTAIN, ALL_ALPINE, ALL_PALISADES; not expanded to individual lifts)
'<lifts> closed for the day/remainder' or 'off (the) schedule' or 'now closed'
'All lifts ... are now closed for the day' (lifts = all)
Whole-resort or whole-side closure with no lift named: 'Palisades Tahoe is CLOSED today', 'ALL LIFTS CLOSED TODAY', 'will not have any lift operations' (lift = ALL_PALISADES / ALL_ALPINE / ALL)
Hedged wording in any post: 'winds may impact lift operations', 'please EXPECT DELAYS', 'possible wind holds' (a prediction; post-level, lift None)
'Delayed Opening' or '<lift> on a mechanical delay'
'<lifts> is/are (now/also) open' or 're-opened'
Parking lots full / parking at <alternate lot>
No prefix needed: 4+ lifts named with a time range (e.g. 9am-4pm) and no hold/close verb
Downloads only / mid-station only / sightseeing only / closing at <time> for maintenance
Weather report: starts 'Palisades:' / 'Alpine:' / 'Snow and Weather:' with no lift roster (filtered)
Road status, promotions, safety message, events (filtered)
Roster with asterisks ('noted with * below: Tram*, Funitel'): each lift is a scheduled opening
'We plan to spin/run/open ...' morning plan: a reopening read becomes a scheduled opening
Scheduled opening by substitution ('X will run today instead of Y') or from a status-list roster
Whole-side wording with no lift named: 'all operations ... on hold', 'the scheduled lifts are on hold' (lift = the side)
Asterisked lift in an asterisk roster: a wind warning for that lift
Group scope with named exceptions ('all upper mountain lifts except ...' on hold, or closed): lift = the group, exceptions listed
'All lifts on hold will be closed for the remainder of the day' (lift = ALL_ON_HOLD, with exceptions)
Whole-side hold or delay with the lifts that are still running as exceptions ('only X is open')
'<lifts> are off (of) the schedule' after the same lifts were rostered earlier in the post: the roster is replaced by closures
The lift that was swapped out in an 'X instead of Y' substitution, or an excluded lift in a roster
Whole-side delay wording ('all lifts delayed', 'all scheduled lifts will be delayed') (lift = the side)
Gondola wind alert stage (Base to Base): an operating status, not a hedge
Squaw-era (2015-18): start-time wording ('anticipated start time of 10am', 'projected for 9:30') or late opening; delay if later than 9am, else scheduled
Squaw-era: 'Open now: <lifts>' / 'Operations: <lifts>' roster (scheduled when the post says 'operations')
Squaw-era: '<lifts> joined the wind hold list'
Squaw-era: '<lifts> added to tomorrow's/today's schedule'
Squaw-era: 'Upper Mtn starts on windhold' (lift = UPPER_MOUNTAIN)
Squaw-era: '<lifts> experiencing electrical/mechanical/technical issues' (mechanical hold)
Squaw-era: '<lifts> officially closed for the day' closure wording
Squaw-era: bare '<lifts> open' / 'now open' with no schedule words
Squaw-era: '<lifts> on <cause> hold' / 'starts the day on hold'
Squaw-era: 'WIND HOLDS except <lifts>' (lift = ALL_OTHER, the named lifts are exceptions)
Squaw-era: '<lift> at <time>' (delay if later than 9am, else scheduled opening)
Fallback: a lift named in a status sentence no earlier rule claimed; the event type follows the sentence (scheduled, reopen, closed, delay or hold)
